title: Financial Trust to Black Family Partners: What the November 2012 Records Show
editorial_boundary: The records establish a documented sale package and bank receipt. They do not, by themselves, establish wrongdoing, motive, operational control, or causation.

sources.role: November 2012 draft package sale; $5.5 million aggregate price
Nov. 26 email forwarding purchase-and-sale package; $5.5 million price; Nov. 30 target close
Accounting allocation: $5m ESW, $250k AP SHL, $250k AP Technology
Nov. 30 JPMorgan statement representation of $5,500,030 CHIPS credit from Black Family Partners
File-cabinet index describing purchase and sale, allocation schedule, assignments, stock powers, and wire-transfer notice
Stock power covering 13,198,711 certificate shares; separate instruction for 151,494 broker-held shares
2014 filing attributing post-split ESW position to Black Family Partners
Independent review describing Financial Trust investments in AP SHL, AP Technology, and ESWW alongside Black-family interests

open_questions: Why the Nov. 30 bank credit is $30 above the stated $5.5 million price.
Released signature pages are incomplete; later SEC filings provide post-closing ownership corroboration.
Transfer-agent/certificate administration continued after the economic sale.
